title: Extra-arms overnight follow-up: OLMo audit information loss, observation interventions, size by memory
status: EXPLORATORY. Motivated by already observed arm 9a results. Frozen here before any new comparison is computed; this does not make it preregistered.

definitions.y: number of high bids in rounds 16-20, 0..5n
definitions.primary_event: F = 1 (every agent high in every round 16-20), i.e. y = 5n
definitions.state: s = (own last action, high neighbours), o = own last message, c = (high, low, none) neighbour message counts
definitions.kernel: K(a, m | s, o, c), the 6-vector over a in (H, L) x m in (high, low, none), a-major; START separate
definitions.profile: tuple of the 4 agents' (a, m) outputs, 6^4 = 1,296 profiles
definitions.all_H_set: the 81 profiles in which all 4 agents bid H (any messages)

variants.both: K(. | s, o, c): the enumerated table itself
variants.own_only: sum_c w(c) K(. | s, o, c), w = Multinomial(2; 1/3, 1/3, 1/3)

E1_audit_variants.averaging: the joint six-outcome vector is averaged; every variant emits its own messages and evolves autonomously; START is identical in all four
E1_audit_variants.weights_sensitivity: equal weight on each of the 6 neighbour-message compositions (own message still uniform); reported, never chosen by result
checks: entries >= 0 and rows sum to 1 within 1e-12
both reproduces the existing signal_aware exact law within 1e-12
neither's action law equals the existing 16-profile actions-only exact law within 1e-12
independent reconstruction (separately written per-agent loop) of selected rows and of the four endpoint laws within 1e-12
outputs_exact: expected excess CRPS against the both law: sum_k (Q(k) - G(k))^2 / 20
E1_audit_variants.outputs_live: CRPS of each variant on the 50 arm 9a runs; paired per-run differences variant minus both, 95% whole-run bootstrap, B = 2000, seed 20261108
E1_audit_variants.recovery_tolerance: a variant recovers the reference outcome if |P_v(F=1) - P_both(F=1)| <= 0.01 AND expected excess CRPS <= 0.001; the smallest tested retained information meeting both is reported; all variants reported regardless

mechanism_diagnostics.occupancy: P(all_H at round t) under both, t = 1..20
mechanism_diagnostics.own_message_composition: within all_H profiles under both: share of agent slots with own message high / low / none, per round and occupancy-weighted over rounds 2-20; compared with the audit's uniform 1/3
mechanism_diagnostics.entry: P(enter all_H at round t from outside) under both
mechanism_diagnostics.exit: one-step exit probability from all_H at round t under each variant kernel, applied to the both chain's distribution over all_H profiles at t (an occupancy-weighted ORACLE diagnostic, not an audit)
mechanism_diagnostics.survival: finite-horizon persistence S_v(h) = pi_entry Q_v^h 1, h = 0..19, Q_v the all_H submatrix of variant v; pi_entry = the both chain's distribution over all_H profiles at first entry, pooled over entry rounds 1..20 (primary, common to all variants); each variant's own pi_entry as secondary
mechanism_diagnostics.table_grid: K(H | s, o, c) for every s, o, c (heatmap), not only the H-2 slice

E1_audit_variants.llama_control: the four variants on Llama's enumerated n = 4 table, same outputs; live scoring on Llama arm 4b runs 0-49 as secondary. Fixed comparison, not a model selection.

E2_observation_interventions.label: model-based counterfactual observation interventions on the cached, validated kernel; not new live measurements

processes.own_null: own last message in the observation replaced by none
processes.neighbour_null: neighbour message counts in the observation replaced by (0, 0, 2)

E2_observation_interventions.unchanged: prompt wording, payoffs, action history, neighbour action counts, last payoff, labels, K; round 1 START; agents emit and neighbours receive actual messages unless the neighbour channel is nulled
secondary: all_H survival under each process's own entry distribution
E2_observation_interventions.interaction: P_unmodified - P_neighbour_null - P_own_null + P_both_null (channels available to agents: both present - own only - neighbours only + neither)
E2_observation_interventions.precision: exact; numerical tolerance 1e-12, no sampling intervals
E2_observation_interventions.sensitivity_uniform: replace each hidden message independently by a uniform signal at each observation, integrated into the local kernel. By construction this has the same law as the E1 averaged variants (own randomised = neighbours_only, neighbours randomised = own_only, both = neither); computed through the intervention code and checked against E1 within 1e-12, and reported as that identity
E2_observation_interventions.own_message_grid: K(H | s, o, c) for all three o at every s and c

live_validation.run_if: E3 is complete and the cost projection fits
live_validation.design: n = 4 cycle, last-1 history, T = 20, 50 runs per cell, base seed 20261107, seeds Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence([20261107, arm_id, 0, run])))
live_validation.logs: actual outputs, transformed observation, prompt hashes, probabilities, random draws, drift
live_validation.checks: per decision: logged probabilities equal the table entry of the transformed state at the floor (0); per run: the G5 discrete Monte Carlo p-value of the run-level gap against that cell's exact law, familywise alpha 0.01 Bonferroni over 4 cells (0.0025 each). A failure is reported, not loosened.

E3_size_by_memory.fixed: OLMo revision 6e5971d9..., cycle, degree 2, cheap-talk prompt, T = 20, payoffs (12, 10, 4, 0), base seed 20261107 (seed namespaces disjoint by arm_id)
E3_size_by_memory.cpu_forecast_before_spend: n10_last1: 100,000 simulated runs of the both chain (enumerated table) and of the actions-only chain, rng seed 20261108, Monte Carlo SE reported; n4_full: exact law on 1,296 profiles from the 9b sampled full-history tables
E3_size_by_memory.table_reuse: n4_full uses the 9b sampled d = 2 full-history tables: the prompt is a function of degree, history and payoffs only (Query carries no n); the kernel-fingerprint check in analyse.py must pass
E3_size_by_memory.benchmark: 5 runs of n10_last1 first; project the rest with a x1.25 margin; stop the live part if the projection does not fit the follow-up GPU ceiling
secondary: consensus timing (first round of a 3-round consensus, censored at T - 2)
E3_size_by_memory.intervals: P(F=1): Clopper-Pearson 95%; differences of P(F=1): Newcombe hybrid score 95%; mean F and its differences: whole-run bootstrap (independent resampling of each cell), B = 2000, seed 20261108
contrasts: memory within size: n4_full - n4_last1, n10_full - n10_last1
size within memory: n10_last1 - n4_last1, n10_full - n4_full
E3_size_by_memory.per_decision_check: n10_last1 logged probabilities against the enumerated table at floor 0

not_done_tonight: changes to payoffs, temperature, tokens or prompts
